pcma.heading: PCMA filament change
pcma.attribution: PrusaConnectMoonrakerAdapter by D3ADD3V3R, built on Prusa Connect Local by Prusa Research a.s.
pcma.unsupported: This printer does not offer the PCMA filament workflow. Update the adapter and regenerate its capability profile.
pcma.intro: Select a material and optionally a spool from Materials. The printer receives the material type and color. Its local confirmation is required before PCMA records the assignment. Materials itself is unchanged.
pcma.failure: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and permissions for PCMA, the printer and Materials.
pcma.confirmAtPrinter: Complete the change at the printer. Reopening this tab checks the saved request and never repeats the printer command.
pcma.archiveHint: This archives the saved request only. It does not stop the printer or cancel a filament operation. Check the physical printer before starting another request. An API assignment already in flight may still finish.
pcma.assigned: The confirmed material or spool was assigned in Materials.
pcma.alreadyPending: Resolve or archive the existing request first.
pcma.notReady: The printer is disconnected, busy, or does not support this workflow.
pcma.uncertain: The command outcome is uncertain. Check the printer; it will not be sent again automatically.
pcma.assignmentFailed: The printer confirmed the material, but Materials could not save the assignment. Check permissions and spool availability, then retry the assignment. Materials also refuses assignments during printing and pause; retry when idle.
pcma.targetChanged: The selected material or spool changed after the request. The assignment has not been changed.
pcma.invalidMetadata: Select an FFF material with a supported material ID and a known RGB color.
pcma.invalidJournal: A saved PCMA request is invalid. No new printer command was sent.
pcma.spoolUnavailable: The spool is archived, missing, or assigned to another printer.
pcma.tooManySpools: This material has too many spools to read in one request.
pcma.status.prepared: Saved before sending. If the page was interrupted, the outcome may be unknown.
pcma.assignmentChanged: The Materials assignment changed after this request. PCMA did not overwrite it.
